title: Tidepool
symptom: User requests feature support for Tidepool, as healthcare professionals use Tidepool as main source for BG and insulin data, and Nightscout is not widely accepted by physicians. Currently xDrip allows uploading but with very limited support.
cause: Tidepool's API does not support uploading all data, particularly the profile, which is a big problem. The Tidepool plugin exists but is disabled because data cannot be uploaded correctly.
evidence_quote: Problem is that Tidepool doesn't allow to upload everything (profile is big problem), and until they extend their APIs there is nothing for us to do.
